sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine] On the night of Nov 7, Ukrainian missile forces using Neptune coastal missile systems struck JSC Proton-Elektroteks in Oryol; a direct hit was confirmed, a fire broke out and explosions were heard. [VERIFIED FACT -- General Staff via Militarnyi/Kyiv Independent] The plant makes optoelectronic equipment and power semiconductors, incl. modules for Kh-71 Kover cruise missiles and inverter-switches for 9M723 Iskander-M ballistic missiles; it was previously hit by Storm Shadow missiles on Oct 23. [STRONGLY SUPPORTED -- Exilenova+/ASTRA via Kyiv Independent + Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA)] Ukrainian drones struck the Saratov Oil Refinery (Rosneft, ~7M tonnes/yr capacity, 4.8M tonnes processed in 2023); several separate fires on the premises; ASTRA geolocated the burning facility from eyewitness video. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- Exilenova+ via Kyiv Independent] A large fire broke out at the Almaz military factory in Rostov; explosions in Belgorod. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Russian MoD via BBC Russian service, carried by Ukrinform] Russian air defence 'intercepted and destroyed' 411 Ukrainian UAVs overnight across 10 regions plus Crimea, the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov. [CONTEXT -- Ukrinform] The Afipsky Oil Refinery in Krasnodar Krai was also hit by drones overnight Nov 6 (fire reported); Zelenskyy said Nov 6 Ukraine will keep striking Russia's oil industry in response to attacks on Ukraine's power grid.
sections.what_verified: 3 distinct declared-tier publisher families: General Staff official statement (T1, STATE UA, primary source) + Kyiv Independent (T2) + Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA, citing ASTRA for the refinery identification). Kyiv Post, Militarnyi, UA.news, Zot.news, Europe Says, Daily Baltic and the monitoring channels (Exilenova+, ASTRA, Supernova+) carry the story but have NO declared tier in the registry and do NOT count toward corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: Russian MoD claims 411 UAVs intercepted/destroyed in one night -- yet both governors confirmed damage and fires on the ground, which contradicts a clean-intercept framing; the MoD figure is a single-origin claim with no wreckage accounting. Missile-type conflict: monitoring channels allege Flamingo cruise missiles were used at Oryol, while the General Staff says Neptune coastal systems -- UNRESOLVED which system. Kyiv Independent text says 'the General Staff reported on Nov. 4' for the Oryol strike -- evidently a dating error in KI, since the strike, the General Staff statement quoted by UA.news ('On the night of November 7...') and all other reporting place it Nov 6-7. Saratov refinery damage extent is unassessed at time of writing (Europe Says).
sections.why_matters: Proven set: Russia-Ukraine long-range strikes + refinery targeting. Hard counted numbers in title: 411 drones claimed intercepted vs 3 Russian cities burning; Proton makes Iskander-M parts -- Ukraine hit the factory that builds the missiles fired at Kyiv the same night. Map-led: Oryol-Saratov-Rostov triangle + the Kyiv strike it answers.
